Abstract Overleaf(Archived) :  https://www.overleaf.com/9462389573gbgdthnsvjzj#45ef1c

Individual: 
https://gitlab.inria.fr/netmob2025/data-challenge/-/blob/main/docs/NetMob25%20Dataset%20Slides.pdf?ref_type=heads
ID: Unique individual identifier
CODGEO: INSEE code of municipality of residence
AREA_NAME: Municipality name
SEX: Sex of the individual (Woman/Man)
AGE: Age in years
DIPLOMA: Highest diploma obtained, from no diploma to doctoral level
PRO CAT: Socio-professional category (1–8)
1(Craftsman,tradesman, and business owner 
2(Executive and senior intellectual profession  
3(Intermediate profession)
4(Employee)  
5(Worker)   
6(Retired or pre-retired)   
7(Student or high school student)  
8(Unemployed or inactive)  
TYPE HOUSE: Type of household or cohabitation status (e.g., In a shared appartment)
NBPERS HOUSE: Number of persons in household
NB_10, NB_11_17, NB_18_24, NB_25_64, NB_65: Number of household members in each age range
PMR: Mobility impairment indicator
DRIVING_LICENCE: Possession of a driving licence for cars (B)
NB_CAR: Number of cars in household
TWO_WHEELER, BIKE, ELECT_SCOOTER: Number of other mobility devices
NAVIG_SUB, IMAGINER_SUB, OTHER_SUB_PT: Public transport subscriptions
BIKE_SUB, NSM_SUB: Other mobility service subscriptions
WEIGHT_INDIV: Statistical weighting coefficient
GPS_RECORD: Boolean indicating whether the individual has associated GPS records
